requested_parts: Intercom forcing another Move out of Combat
answers.answer:
1. Captain cannot use Order while personally in Combat.
2. Intercom may cause someone else to Move out of Combat.
3. Their movement uses normal Escape rule, including attacks before leaving and normal destination resolution.

requested_parts: Motivation with active Intercom who draws
answers.answer: 1. With Intercom, Motivation affects all Characters in Rooms with a Computer as well as all Characters in Captain’s Room. The summary does not specify additional details about how many cards each draws beyond the card’s effect.

requested_parts: Door Exploration placement via Technical Corridors movement
answers.answer: 1. Ignore a Door Exploration token when entering via Technical Corridors Action or Technical Corridor Plans Item because the entry Corridor cannot be determined; do not place a Door.

requested_parts: remote Order Interruption when not in Captain Room
answers.answer:
1. No. Interruption requires being in same Room as Character performing interrupted Action; remote Order via Intercom cannot be Interrupted from elsewhere.
2. Passing does not bar Interruption; FAQ permits Interruption after passing if its location requirement is met.

requested_parts: automatic pass after hand empty following two Actions
answers.answer:
1. No. Empty hand after two Actions does not make you pass automatically; wait until next round to pass.
2. That extra round may incur another Fire or Bleeding effect.

requested_parts: Rest multiple Infected cards with no prior Larva

2. Rest can be fatal if Larva was already on Character board before it.

requested_parts: Noise location when throwing at Nest eggs from neighboring Room
answers.answer: 1. Roll Noise in your own Room, not the Nest.

requested_parts: repeated Storage Room Action at zero counter
answers.answer:
1. Yes. Storage Room Action can be used repeatedly at zero Item Counter, paying normal cost and restrictions.
2. Counter limits Search Action card; ordinary Search lowers counter by one and is unavailable at zero except Scout Scavenging.

requested_parts: Egg destruction each Fire Damage step with Nest on Fire and Vulnerability
answers.answer: 1. Two Nest Eggs are destroyed per Fire Damage step with Vulnerability to Fire (otherwise one).

requested_parts: whether dropped board Egg restores Nest total
answers.answer: 1. No. Egg taken from Intruder board and dropped back into Nest is a normal Heavy Object and does not restore Nest’s Egg total/hit points.

requested_parts: Medkit and Bandages use on others
answers.answer: 1. Yes. Medkit and Bandages may be used on other Characters.

requested_parts: direct Energy Charge reload of another Weapon
answers.answer:

2. Trade them the Energy Charge; they use it in their own round to recharge their Weapon.

requested_parts: whether Alcohol’s Infected scan places a Larva
answers.answer:

requested_parts: Add Item effect on used/empty Energy Weapon

requested_parts: whether Hand Serious Wound affects Scout Motion Scanner
answers.answer:
1. No. It does not affect Scout Motion Scanner.
2. Motion Scanner is a unique reaction, not an Item Action.

requested_parts: Injuries per Intruder in burning Room
answers.answer:
1. Each Intruder in a burning Room takes 1 Injury.
2. Fire Damage step is after Intruder Attacks and before Event card.
